summary: Colville NF lookout site in Pend Oreille County: 40-ft pole L-4 tower built 1934, removed or destroyed in the 1950s; no source describes the site since.

facts.status_note: Tower removed or destroyed in the 1950s; sources differ on which, and none describes what remains

events.note: Registered December 17, 2012 as US 1520, WA 420; nominated by Ray Kresek

evidence.supports: about 10 miles east of Metaline Falls
administered by the U.S. Forest Service
built 1934 as a 40-foot pole L-4 tower; removed in the 1950s
evidence.quote: Built in 1934, this 40' pole L-4 tower was removed in the 1950s

evidence.supports: 1934 40-foot pole L-4 tower; destroyed in the 1950s
built 1934 as a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab
evidence.quote: In 1934, a 40-foot pole tower with L-4 cab was built.

evidence.supports: WillhiteWeb: removed or destroyed in the 1950s
evidence.quote: It was removed or destroyed in the 1950s.

evidence.supports: no source describes the site since the 1950s; the decade is the only date given for its fate
author had not visited the site yet
1967 USGS map marks a trail ending at the lookout point, updated 1971
evidence.quote: 1967 USGS, 1971 update. Trail ends at lookout point on this map

resolved_conflicts.explanation: The register says removed in the 1950s; Firelookout.com says destroyed in the 1950s; WillhiteWeb says removed or destroyed in the 1950s. The decade is the only date all three give.

sources.title: Pass Creek Ridge Fire Lookout Tower

notes_for_editor: Thin record: no staffing, fire, or access information in any source read, so none is in the story. The removal has no year, so no dated removal event is recorded. The WillhiteWeb 1967/1971 USGS note is a map label, not a description of the site today.
